info.title: Soltex Global Admin API
info.description: Authentication, second factors, users, audit (Phase C) and content management (Phase E). Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json) with `request_id`; every response carries `X-Request-ID`. State-changing requests need the header `x-requested-with: soltex-admin`.

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password
post.description: Creates a session (cookie). If the user has a second factor, `next` is `mfa_required` and only the MFA routes work until it is verified.

post.summary: Sign out (revokes this session)

get.summary: Current session, user, permissions and MFA state

post.summary: Revoke one of my sessions
Sign out everywhere else
Change my password
post.description: Revokes all my other sessions and rotates the current session token.

post.summary: Request a password-reset link
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the account exists.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description: Revokes every session of the user. Does not sign in (the second factor is never bypassed).

get.summary: My second factors and the requirement of my role

post.summary: Verify a TOTP code (sign-in second factor or step-up)
Use a one-time recovery code (lost device)
Start TOTP enrollment
post.description: Returns the secret and the otpauth:// URI (for a QR code) once. Confirm with a code to activate.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrollment with a first code
post.description: If this is the first second factor, the session is raised to assurance 2 and recovery codes are returned (once).

post.summary: Generate new recovery codes (step-up required)
post.description: All previous codes stop working. The new codes are returned once.

post.summary: Start registering a passkey
post.description: Returns PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON. The challenge is bound to this session, valid 5 minutes, single use.

post.summary: Finish registering a passkey
post.description: If this is the first second factor, the session is raised to assurance 2 and recovery codes are returned (once).

post.summary: Start a passkey check (sign-in second factor or step-up)
post.description: Returns PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON for the passkeys of the signed-in user.

post.summary: Finish a passkey check

delete.summary: Remove one of my passkeys (step-up required)

post.summary: Create a user (step-up required)
post.description: Only an Owner can create an Owner. The initial password is given to the user out of band; they must enroll MFA at first sign-in when their role requires it.

patch.summary: Change name, role or status (step-up required)
patch.description: Each field is authorised separately. Role and status changes sign the user out everywhere.

post.summary: Reset a user's second factors (lost device; step-up required)
post.description: Removes passkeys, TOTP and recovery codes and signs the user out everywhere; they must enroll again at the next sign-in.

post.summary: Sign a user out everywhere (step-up required)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in the source-language title, slug and key

post.summary: Create a draft in projects
post.description: Creates a draft. Required: the title and what cannot be empty (images, relations). Other languages start as untranslated copies. A slug or SEO texts need seo.edit; without a slug one is proposed from the title.

patch.description: Send only changed fields and If-Match with the version you edited. 409 edit_conflict when someone saved in between. SEO fields need seo.edit, all others content.edit. Lists: each item names its current position (`from`) or null when new, so translations stay attached.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: Required. Version the change is based on (the ETag of GET), e.g. "3"
